title: Tell us what HP tests: the hosted site or the v2.1 HTML prototype?
bluf: HP's UAT pack (367 cases, none run) tests the v2.1 HTML prototype, not our hosted site. Of 285 functional cases, 111 match the site, 48 partly, 126 are missing (about 80 are a sales layer: pipeline, quotes, contracts). The pass rule is 100% of P0/P1 cases, and 98 of those cannot pass today. Recommend we test the hosted site and defer the prototype-only cases with a signed deferral each. Default if you do not tap: Tuesday holds UAT and sends nothing to anyone, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10).

options.label: Test the hosted site; defer prototype-only cases
options.detail: Each deferred case needs a signed deferral record. Matches what we built and 'layout is Phase 2'. Tuesday drafts the deferral list for you to send.

options.label: Test the HTML prototype as written
options.detail: 98 P0/P1 cases fail on the site; would need a large sales-layer build first. Not possible before December.

options.label: Ask Paul first
options.detail: You raise it with Paul before anything is decided; UAT stays on hold.

default_action: Hold UAT, no message to anyone, no change to the build. Tuesday drafts the case-by-case deferral list for A so it is ready.
